description: This file defines a utility function for initializing a Supabase client in a React environment, using environment variables for configuration. It imports the 'createClient' function from the '@supabase/supabase-js' library and exports a function that conditionally creates and returns a client instance.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient()
methods.description: Initializes and returns a Supabase client if environment variables are set; returns null otherwise.
